title: Book plate
slide_intent: Leave room for personal ownership within a branded object because a useful identity can support participation rather than merely occupy space.
strategic_value: A writable name line can turn Whitney’s graphic vocabulary into a personal connection with a purchased book.
demonstration: A white book plate sets Whitney and colored words around a thin W and adds a Name line beneath.
practical_value: Compare the fixed museum name, playful phrase and writable field when designing a small personalized item.

content_islands.name: Identity and phrase
content_islands.spec: Arrange Whitney and the colored library phrase along the W strokes.

content_islands.name: Personalization
content_islands.spec: Keep the Name label and blank rule beneath the graphic.

reference_purposes.Application: The official caption identifies the object as a book plate for the museum’s retail store.
